conflicts.description: If round 1 really passes (test Result is `verified`), cw-019.0 forbids creating fix_2, but cw-006.0 still requires fix_2 to exist and cw-010.0 requires its follow-up test_2, so an honest run that passes in round 1 can't satisfy all three.
